entities.name: Methyl ester saponification
observations: The reactant methyl benzoate motif is converted to the corresponding benzoic acid; the aryl ether, aryl chloride, NH, and fused N-heteroaromatic framework are retained.
The reaction center is cleavage of the ester O–CH3 bond, producing carboxylate under basic conditions followed by protonation.

entities.name: LiOH THF water AcOH
observations: A directly matching record uses LiOH and water in tetrahydrofuran, followed by acetic acid for acidification/workup.
Equivalent NaOH or KOH aqueous hydrolysis conditions are chemically plausible but not directly confirmed by the cited record.

entities.name: Ester-to-acid conversion
observations: No evidence supports ring formation, coupling, chlorination, or redox; the supported assignment is ester hydrolysis/workup.
